Northstar Analytics — Data Analyst Co-op

Northstar Analytics is a fictional employer used only for automated testing. The
student will clean sample operational data, write SQL queries, create Power BI
reports, and explain data-quality findings to a small analytics team.

Location: Toronto, Ontario. Work mode: Hybrid, with two office days each week.
Work term: January 4 to August 27, 2027 (8 months).
Application deadline: October 15, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Eastern.
Published: September 15, 2026.

Applicants should be enrolled in a Canadian university co-op program and should
be comfortable with Python, SQL, Excel, and clear written communication. This
fixture does not establish whether any real job is open and must never be used
as evidence about a real employer.
